text: Lesson 17 introduced a Job as tasks plus a trigger plus compute. Here's where that structure actually gets built by hand — the Workflows UI's visual canvas.
Each task appears as a box on a canvas. Clicking it opens task type, cluster, and parameters — every setting a bundle's YAML would declare in text has a matching field right here.
Once a run starts, the same canvas becomes a live status view — each task box changes color as it queues, runs, and finishes, watched task by task.
Building a job in the Workflows UI and declaring the same job in a Databricks Asset Bundle produce the identical underlying object — two paths to the same job.
The canvas is how a person builds a job; the job itself is the same object either way. Next up: what those dragged dependency lines actually mean.
